name: q104
question:
How did speech evolve and what parts of the brain control it?
The most prevalent theory is that speech, controlled by the left hemisphere of the cerebrum, developed about 200,000 years ago, although new insight suggests it could have been as much as \~27 million years ago in a common human and monkey ancestor. But how speech evolved and why it is centered in the left brain remain unclear.
title: Speech Evolution and Brain
